initial_query: If a teardown_request callback raises, later request cleanup and application-context teardown no longer run. Please make teardown continue through the remaining cleanup phases and report teardown errors only after cleanup, without changing normal teardown behavior.

feedback_by_state.primary: A teardown_request failure is still preventing the request object from being closed.
feedback_by_state.edge: The application-context teardown still does not run after a request-teardown failure.
feedback_by_state.exception: Cleanup now runs, but the original teardown failure is being swallowed or replaced.
feedback_by_state.regression: Normal teardown order or cleanup behavior changed even when no teardown callback fails.

success_condition: All hidden grader states pass: primary, edge, exception, regression.
